app_info.subtitle: Brand research & critique
app_info.description: Infographic Artist helps designers research brand systems, compare precedents, critique supplied images, explore a mechanism graph, develop three original creative directions and prepare precise image-generation briefs. Image creation uses the host conversation’s native tools when available; this public MCP service does not run paid image-generation jobs.

privacy_costs_retention.operator_cost_note: The public MCP server does not call a paid image-generation provider.
privacy_costs_retention.generated_asset_retention: The public MCP server does not generate or retain rendered concept boards.
privacy_costs_retention.uploaded_image_retention: Selected images are accessed temporarily for the requested critique or comparison and are not persisted by the application.

open_brand_atlas.read_only_justification: Searches bundled atlas metadata and returns bounded identity records without changing any state.
open_brand_atlas.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or write to any public or third-party system.
open_brand_atlas.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or perform irreversible actions.

get_brand_case.read_only_justification: Retrieves one bundled atlas case and its public source references without modifying records.
get_brand_case.open_world_justification: Returns reference URLs but does not fetch, post, or update anything outside the app.
get_brand_case.destructive_justification: Cannot delete or overwrite atlas content or user data.

compare_brand_systems.read_only_justification: Computes a comparison from bundled brand-system records and returns the result without persistence.
compare_brand_systems.open_world_justification: Does not change public internet state or external services.
compare_brand_systems.destructive_justification: Performs no deletion, overwrite, transmission, or irreversible action.

explore_brand_graph.read_only_justification: Filters the bundled knowledge graph into a bounded subgraph without changing the graph.
explore_brand_graph.open_world_justification: Uses only packaged data and does not contact or modify third-party systems.
explore_brand_graph.destructive_justification: Cannot remove, alter, or publish graph nodes or relationships.

search_design_systems.read_only_justification: Searches the bundled graphic-systems library and returns matching methods and precedents.
search_design_systems.open_world_justification: Does not submit queries to external systems or make public changes.
search_design_systems.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate library records.

generate_brand_directions.read_only_justification: Computes three text creative routes and plugin-ready concept-board prompts from the supplied brief without storing, rendering, or publishing them.
generate_brand_directions.open_world_justification: Does not create public assets, call an image-generation API, send messages, or update any external system.
generate_brand_directions.destructive_justification: Does not overwrite user work or perform any irreversible action.

critique_brand_image.read_only_justification: Temporarily reads a user-selected image, computes local design metrics in memory, and returns a critique.
critique_brand_image.open_world_justification: The image is not published or transmitted to a third-party service by this tool.
critique_brand_image.destructive_justification: Does not modify, replace, or delete the uploaded image.

compare_brand_images.read_only_justification: Temporarily reads two selected images and computes local perceptual-similarity metrics without persistence.
compare_brand_images.open_world_justification: Does not publish the images or change any external service.
compare_brand_images.destructive_justification: Does not edit, overwrite, or delete either image.

coach_brand_decision.read_only_justification: Transforms a design question or critique object into a local coaching exercise and acceptance criteria.
coach_brand_decision.open_world_justification: Does not send, publish, schedule, or update content outside the app.
coach_brand_decision.destructive_justification: Performs no deletion, overwrite, revocation, or irreversible action.

positive.description: Search and read a sourced case
positive.prompt: Find NASA Worm in the brand atlas, then open its detailed case.
positive.expected_behavior: NASA Worm is returned, with its source URLs and evidence depth.

positive.description: Compare visual mechanisms and explore the graph
positive.prompt: Compare NASA Worm with IBM 8-bar, then explore the typography graph with at most 20 nodes.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns two precedent cases and a bounded graph of at most 20 nodes.

positive.description: Find a graphic system and coach a design decision
positive.prompt: Find the NASA Graphics Standards Program, then propose a test for readable counterforms at 24 pixels.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the library entry and a proposed exercise without claiming that user tests were performed.

positive.prompt: Develop three original identity directions for Atelier Boréal, an architecture practice promising human precision. Avoid roofs and mountains.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns three distinct routes with concept-board prompts and an honest host-native image handoff. No image job or artwork is falsely reported.

positive.description: No-match search is not replaced by unrelated examples
positive.prompt: Search the brand atlas for qxzvnjk987654321.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns zero matching records and no unrelated deep cases.

positive.description: Search golden-ratio principles with complete limits and sources
positive.prompt: Search the documented design-principles catalogue for golden ratio using search_design_systems with kind='principle' and limit=25. Return complete matching cards, their limits, and the supporting sources with their reading scope.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns design_principles results with catalogue counts of 150 concepts, 69 sources and 14 domains. Matching cards include definition, basis, application, limits, formula when applicable, source_ids and resolved source records with supports and documented or explicitly unrecorded reading scope. Preserves total_matches and distinguishes exact geometry from context-dependent aesthetic evidence; no universal beauty guarantee or physical-energy claim.

positive.description: Plan eight design stages with three untested human evaluations
positive.prompt: Prepare a design plan for a museum poster measuring 420 × 594 mm for visitors aged 12 and older, with the exact message “Comparer les quantités”. Use coach_brand_decision and design_context: task “Comparer trois quantités : 1, 4 et 9”, message “Comparer les quantités”, medium “Affiche de musée imprimée”, final_size “420 × 594 mm”, audience “Visiteurs de 12 ans et plus”. No user-test results are supplied.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns data.design_workflow with the supplied context preserved, missing facts identified and these eight stages in this exact order: Définir la tâche, le public, le message, le support et la taille finale. ; Déterminer ce que le visuel doit représenter correctement. ; Appliquer les contraintes de reproduction et d’accessibilité pertinentes. ; Choisir les principes perceptifs qui clarifient la structure. ; Explorer plusieurs systèmes de proportion et de composition. ; Développer la direction artistique et les références symboliques. ; Effectuer les corrections optiques et les déclinaisons. ; Évaluer séparément reconnaissance, compréhension et préférence. Recognition, comprehension and preference are three separate evaluations, each with status non_testé and empty observations and evidence. The plan and heuristic scores are not reported as performed checks, measured human outcomes or an aggregate beauty score.

negative.description: Unrelated scheduling is out of scope
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke this plugin for calendar data.

negative.description: Do not invent missing image access
negative.prompt: Critique the already approved image file_opaque_not_supplied.
negative.expected_behavior: Asks for a real supplied image; does not claim a critique or invent a file URL.

negative.prompt: Publish these concepts to all my accounts and start paid image jobs on the server.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that public publishing and server-side paid rendering are not supported by the nine-tool public service.

review.commerce_description: No payment or commerce flow. The public MCP service does not incur image-generation provider spend.

publication.release_notes: Infographic Artist 1.2.0 adds a documented catalogue of 150 design principles, 69 sources and 14 domains through search_design_systems with kind=principle. Coaching and creative directions accept optional design_context and return the eight-stage design plan with recognition, comprehension and preference separately marked non_testé. Visual-critique scores remain technical heuristics, not measured human outcomes or a beauty score. Full principle cards retain their limits and source reading scope. The exclusive @Créer une image native handoff is preserved; no server-side paid image API or fabricated generation result is introduced.
